data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: for each in-scope corpus case, the test invokes each in-scope engine via its manifest-declared method and asserts the adapter-normalized verdict equals the oracle verdict
- dd-2: the verdict-extraction adapter maps interrupted/timeout engine outcomes to the canonical {pass,fail,skip} vocabulary and rejects an unknown engine-output token with a loud non-zero failure
- dd-3: a case out of scope for an engine (per its harnesses annotation) reports 'out of scope' for that engine instead of asserting a verdict
- dd-4: all intermediate state is created via mktemp and the test runs as part of validate.sh --ci

## Description
Create tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh (Proposal 2: generic manifest-driven loop + inline case-dispatch adapters, PyYAML parse). Implementation requirements:
- Wrap ALL top-level execution (corpus load, invocation loop, summary) under `if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then ... fi` so sourcing the file to unit-call normalize_verdict is side-effect-free.
- Read corpus + manifest paths from env-overridable vars: DSO_CORPUS_INDEX (default tests/runners/fixtures/corpus-index.yaml) and DSO_RUNNER_MANIFEST (default plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml). A missing path triggers a LOUD non-zero failure (not a silent skip).
- Parse corpus-index.yaml + test-runners.yaml via inline python3 + PyYAML (yaml.safe_load — established repo idiom).
- Generic manifest-driven loop: per corpus case, per engine in the case 'harnesses' list, read the engine's manifest invocation method + verdict_adapter NAME, invoke the engine (suite-engine: `bash tests/lib/suite-engine.sh <file>`; bash-runner: `bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=bash --test-dir=<dir> --filter=<pattern>`), capture stdout+exit code.
- normalize_verdict <adapter_name> <raw> <exit_code>: inline `case "$adapter_name" in` block, one arm per manifest adapter NAME; MUST recognize 'suite_engine' as a valid adapter. Maps timeout (exit 124) -> fail and interrupted (exit 130) -> fail (abnormal termination = fail). catch-all `*)` arm (unknown adapter OR unknown token) emits loud 'UNKNOWN VERDICT TOKEN' / 'UNKNOWN ADAPTER' to stderr and returns non-zero (dd-2).
- Assert normalized verdict == case oracle verdict; emit a per-case line '<case-id> <engine>: <verdict> vs <oracle>' for each case×in-scope-engine (dd-1 per-case granularity). Out-of-scope engine (not in case 'harnesses') prints 'out of scope for <engine>' and skips assertion (dd-3).
- All intermediate state via mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/equiv.XXXXXX" (dd-4).
- chmod +x. Add tests/runners/ to the plugin-boundary allowlist if not already. Wire into validate.sh --ci: ensure tests/runners/ is among the dirs validate.sh scans (append-only edit to CMD_TEST_DIRS / test-dir set; do NOT drop existing dirs — note sibling story 0db3 also edits validate.sh, prefer a minimal append to reduce conflict).
RED->GREEN order: write the fixtures first (real-corpus, N-engine, unknown-token, out-of-scope), confirm RED (normalize_verdict + loop do not exist yet), then implement, confirm GREEN.
Cross-story dependency: consumes corpus (0b6a) + manifest (fd41); if absent at run time, fail loudly.

## TDD Test Approach
Given the landed corpus+manifest; When the manifest-driven loop runs over cases×in-scope-engines; Then in-scope adapter-normalized verdict==oracle (exit 0) with per-case comparison lines, a synthesized unknown-token fixture -> normalize_verdict prints 'UNKNOWN VERDICT TOKEN' non-zero, and a case omitting an engine -> 'out of scope for <engine>'.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] test exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh
- [ ] real-corpus run exits 0 (in-scope engines match oracle) [dd-1]
  Verify: bash tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh
- [ ] per-case oracle comparison emitted [dd-1]
  Verify: bash tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh 2>&1 | grep -Eq '[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ .+: (pass|fail|skip) (vs|==) (pass|fail|skip)'
- [ ] sourcing is side-effect-free (BASH_SOURCE guard)
  Verify: bash -c 'source tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh; type normalize_verdict >/dev/null'
- [ ] unknown token -> 'UNKNOWN VERDICT TOKEN' + non-zero [dd-2]
  Verify: bash -c 'source tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh; out=$(normalize_verdict suite_engine zzz-bogus 0 2>&1); rc=$?; printf "%s" "$out" | grep -qF "UNKNOWN VERDICT TOKEN" && [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]'
- [ ] unknown adapter -> 'UNKNOWN ADAPTER' + non-zero [dd-2]
  Verify: bash -c 'source tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh; out=$(normalize_verdict no_such_adapter pass 0 2>&1); rc=$?; printf "%s" "$out" | grep -qF "UNKNOWN ADAPTER" && [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]'
- [ ] timeout 124 -> fail AND interrupted 130 -> fail [dd-2]
  Verify: bash -c 'source tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh; [ "$(normalize_verdict suite_engine "" 124)" = fail ] && [ "$(normalize_verdict suite_engine "" 130)" = fail ]'
- [ ] out-of-scope engine printed [dd-3]
  Verify: bash tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh 2>&1 | grep -Eq 'out of scope for [A-Za-z0-9_-]+'
- [ ] mktemp equiv template used [dd-4]
  Verify: grep -Eq 'mktemp[^\n]*\$\{TMPDIR:-/tmp\}/equiv\.XXXXXX' tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh
- [ ] missing sibling artifact -> loud non-zero (behavioral)
  Verify: bash -c 'DSO_CORPUS_INDEX=/nonexistent/nope.yaml bash tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]'
- [ ] validate.sh scans tests/runners [dd-4]
  Verify: grep -Eq 'tests/runners' plugins/dso/scripts/validate.sh
- [ ] tests/runners allowlisted
  Verify: grep -Eq 'tests/runners' .claude/hooks/pre-commit/plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Create manifest-driven engine-equivalence test (oracle assertion, verdict adapter, scope handling) and wire into validate.sh --ci
